title: Meet Tal Wallenstein
name: Tal Wallenstein, CPA
cta: Great to have you with us!

segments.text: Hi, I'm Tal Wallenstein. CPA, certified board director, and Big Four alumna.
Two years at EY, and two and a half at KPMG.
segments.label: Big Four · EY · KPMG

segments.text: Third generation of accountants in Israel.

segments.label: May 2025
segments.text: In May 2025, I stepped into the world of AI. I studied it, researched it, and couldn't understand how it wasn't adapted to, or built into, the world of finance. I dug deeper, and realized it was there, just not the way we'd want it.

segments.label: Tal & Roei
segments.text: That's when I started AI Finance, together with Roei, who's not only my partner, but also my little brother.
segments.spoken: That's when I started AI Finance, together with Roey, who's not only my partner, but also my little brother.

segments.label: In Israel and abroad
segments.text: Since then, we've worked with many organizations: from freelancers to private and public companies, in Israel and abroad.

segments.label: One goal
segments.text: With one goal: to turn my world from a gray, boring world, drained of energy and passion and full of grunt work, into an interesting, serious world of innovation and building. A world where each of us wants to get up and learn more. A place where the grunt work is left to robots, because we're already building and creating.
We help finance teams bring AI into their daily work: lectures, workshops, and hands-on guidance.

segments.label: Teaching in Israeli academia
segments.text: I also teach the first course of its kind on financial statement analysis with AI.
This is exactly where you come in.
The future of AI starts with people.

segments.label: Human in the loop
segments.text: Our motto today is human in the loop. Not a machine that replaces people, but one that pushes people to move forward together with AI, and build a new, richer world of content.

segments.label: With a smile
segments.text: And all of it with a smile.
So nice to meet you, and great to have you with us.
